verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a mendicant with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is faithless, shameless, imprudent, lazy, and witless.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A mendicant with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho hoti, hirīmā hoti, ottappī hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is faithful, conscientious, prudent, energetic, and wise.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
